title: Trevor J NDE 22363
content: Improvised explosive device bomb blast. I read up on how long it takes to bleed out from the femoral and brachial veins/arteries and it is within seconds.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes IED Bomb upper and lower left extremities damage. Damage to brachial and femoral vein/arteries. Improvised explosive device bomb blast. I read up on how long it takes to bleed out from the femoral and brachial veins/arteries and it is within seconds.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was above the Humvee, I could feel the vehicle in a way but above it and it was dark. Then I was sent to another place.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It felt as if there was a plane of life above this ring of fire I was in and if I were to reach up and touch I may be able to see the past and possibly the future.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Crying, moaning, screams of torture, sadness, pure hell.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I was surrounded by a ring of fire; I could not see my body. Dark figures where around the fire. There were millions of other rings of fires with souls in them. I saw our driver who was a Private being dragged away by the dark figures. I called on Jesus Christ to save me. A hole opened in the red skies and through the hole was a blue sky.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Dark figures and a Private who died in the bomb, being dragged away.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Mentally confused not aware but became stronger as time progress. Extreme emotions of fear. No smell or physical type awareness.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Extreme fear, horror, despair, agony, suffering, confused.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I believe I was in another world or place of existence.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will In this place you cannot even talk but I uttered the words ‘Jesus Christ please save me from this’ and immediately afterwards a hole opened in the red sky and as I gazed through the hole which was a bright blue sky, I was sent right back into my body in the blown up Humvee.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will In this place you cannot even talk but I uttered the words ‘Jesus Christ please save me from this’ and immediately afterwards a hole opened in the red sky and as I gazed through the hole which was a bright blue sky, I was sent right back into my body in the blown up Humvee. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I felt as though I was sent to hell or purgatory and because of my faith in Jesus Christ I was spared. I was in a place where no one in the whole creation of life knew where I was and because I uttered His Name Jesus Christ, I was immediately transported back to my body. Because of the paranormal stuff has led me into a spiritual battle and stronger faith in GOD.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ings Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain Not really I remember it as if it was yesterday but to explain the fear and emotions is hard.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Paranormal activities regarding myself and my family( my wife and four daughters)
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best (if you can call it that)- Increase in my catholic faith Worst- confused at the whole experience and why I had to see the things I saw and what do I do with.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Priest, Radio hosts, friends and family.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have had out of body experiences as a child. I have experienced angels as well as demons as a child. I was on the verge of death when I was five, but the experiences I mentioned happened later at around seven and then at nine or ten.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I had googled a bunch of stuff regarding near death and how long are you conscious after your body has bleed out. The only answers are GOD must have a purpose for you (doesn't he for everyone) or from a scientific point, my consciousness was still operating and everything I experienced was based from the hard drive of my brain. That was what I depicted as hell and stuff. Please help me to understand a little of this and are there others out there as myself. I hear the light at the end of the tunnel or I saw my grandmother hanging clothes in a field of flowers but my experience is totally opposite from that.
